items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; not expected to play per Rapoport. Davante Adams expected to carry the load with elevated routes/targets.
items.why: Hip/groin; McVay noted lack of progress; Rapoport confirms not expected.
items.implication: Adams primary WR1 target share and red-zone upside spikes.
items.opportunity: Adams routes/target rate historically high without Nacua (42% target rate on routes).

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; good longer-term news per Rapoport, Mariota starts.
items.why: Dislocated elbow; no fracture, positive longer-term.
items.implication: Mariota at QB; McLaurin still viable but tough Seattle matchup.

items.text: Texans ruled WR Nico Collins OUT for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring.
items.implication: Opens targets for remaining Texans pass-catchers, especially TE.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz saw 28-30% target share last week without Collins.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe). Coach: Jaylen Warren will lead the group; checkdowns likely for Rodgers.
items.implication: Warren lead back with high snap/carry/checkdown volume; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.opportunity: Warren lead + third-down/checkdown role expansion; vertical pass game struggling so more short work.

items.text: Projecting Qs Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN; hoping early clarity on Zay Flowers (ham), AD Mitchell, DJ Moore.
items.why: Practice trends and ETR models; big DFS implications.
items.implication: Startable if active; monitor morning reports.
items.opportunity: Full roles if cleared; Bowers TE1 upside, Evans WR volume, Warren lead.

items.text: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne listed IN for Sunday; also JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey, Aaron Jones, Jadarian Price IN.
items.implication: Full roles restored; Nabers high-upside WR, Etienne committee but active.
items.opportunity: Nabers routes/targets with Winston; Etienne snaps vs LV.

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Committee back; Coleman out removes competition.
items.opportunity: Both return to share carries/snaps vs Rams.

items.text: With Dowdle OUT, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expecting zillion checkdowns from Rodgers as vertical game failed. Projecting Warren (shoulder Q) in.
items.why: Coach comments + Dowdle absence; practice squad backups Homer/Heidenreich.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with volume spike in PPR.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns/third-down; high snap share.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core surgery, 6-8 weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.opportunity: Hubbard high snap/carry/target share ROS short-term.

items.text: Davante Adams ran 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted on 42%; prior games without him: big production (e.g. 8-195-2).
items.why: Historical route/target data when Nacua absent.
items.implication: Adams WR1 lock with Nacua doubtful.

items.text: ETR projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (top 25th percentile sim average).
items.why: Usage and matchup sims yield extreme high-end outcomes.
items.implication: Elite RB1 with massive ceiling for DFS/season-long.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (high rush prop, DAL 30th rush D) and Chase Brown @ PIT (20+ touches, 15% targets, PIT soft vs RBs).
items.opportunity: Henry volume vs weak run D; Brown dual-threat util.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV soft vs WRs), Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share sans Collins, IND soft vs TEs), Christian Watson vs ATL (high util/RZ).
items.why: Target share, aDOT, matchup data; Collins OUT boosts Schultz.
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz volume; Watson RZ share.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (low snaps/touches post-fumble, tough run D), Travis Etienne vs LV (low util/snaps even with Kamara), Terry McLaurin vs SEA (toughest WR D, low team total).
items.why: Role/snap/util data + matchups; Daniels OUT but SEA elite vs WR.
items.opportunity: Henderson rising in NE; Etienne limited role.
items.conflict: Etienne listed IN by ETR but low util noted.
